_COMMENT_aggregate_signals: AGA_INTEG_GAS, AGA_FIG, AGA_INBOARD_TOTAL, AGA_OUTBOARD_TOTAL are aggregate diagnostic signals with no corresponding IDS path in the gas_injection IDS. They are not mapped here.

valve[#]/voltage/data.COMMENT: Valve drive voltage from XDC gas flow signal. Newer shots (>= 28356) use slash convention (/xdc/gas/f/<n>); older shots use underscore (XDC_GAS_F_<N>). This mapping uses the newer convention.

_COMMENT_target_voltage: gas_injection/valve/target_voltage does not exist in the IMAS DD. The XDC/GAS/T group target voltage signals (/xdc/gas/t/g1-g12) have no valid IDS destination and are not mapped.

_valve[#]/target_voltage/data.COMMENT: No target_voltage path exists in the gas_injection IDS DD
